name: all-mail
description: all-Mail Docker-first Go runtime with a compatibility Fastify business API

scripts.docker:restart: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh docker compose down && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh docker compose up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 240
scripts.install:all: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server install && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web install && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix cloudflare/workers/allmail-edge install
scripts.build:server: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run db:generate && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm run build:server && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm run build:web
scripts.lint: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run lint && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.test: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run test && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run test
scripts.check:go: cd core && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go test -race ./... && go vet ./... && output="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/allmail-release-check-$$" && go build -trimpath -o "$output" ./cmd/allmail && rm -f "$output"
scripts.verify:release: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm run check:go && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run lint && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run lint && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run test && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run test && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run db:generate && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix server run build && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run build && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix cloudflare/workers/allmail-edge run check && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm run audit:prod
